cues: Poultry diseases are a favourite short question.
Newcastle disease and Ranikhet disease are the same thing, caused by a virus that can kill a whole flock.
Coccidiosis is protozoan, not viral, and damages the caeca.
And bird flu, H5N1, first hit Nepal in Jhapa in two thousand and nine.
text: Poultry diseases are a favourite short question. Newcastle disease and Ranikhet disease are the same thing, caused by a virus that can kill a whole flock. Marek's disease causes tumours. Coccidiosis is protozoan, not viral, and damages the caeca. And bird flu, H5N1, first hit Nepal in Jhapa in two thousand and nine.
